notes.title: Prelogate Update 1.3.2
notes.content:
Little update fixing two things.

[h1]Version 1.3.2[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug with colorblind mode hot-key
[*]Changed order of stats to consistent one, now it's devices, laser beam length, logic ticks all across the game
[/list]
Enjoy ːblockː

notes.title: Prelogate Update 1.3.1
notes.content:
Small update with few requested features and fixes.

[h1]Version 1.3.1[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added hot-key for colorblind enhancement (Press B or hold V)
[*]Added 'Save' button in level completion screen so you can save solution to slot with information about clearness, logic ticks and laser length
[*]Added information about hot-key for devices on toolbox
[/list]

Enjoy ːpentagonː

notes.title: Prelogate Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
New update with requested by community features.

[h1]Version 1.3.0[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added '[b]Undo[/b]' and '[b]Redo[/b]' feature
[*]Now you can see global Steam statistics in main menu
[*]Added [b]multiple solution slots[/b] for each level (last solution plus five slots for your own use)
[*]Now you can remove devices with Delete key (also while hovering them)
[*]Added option to skip intro screen
[*]Added tips to logic gates (introduction to their mechanics)
[*]Added four [b]new achievements[/b] (now there is nice, round number of 16 achievements)
[list]
[*]Cleaner - Find clean solution for every level in the game
[*]Savings - Complete chapter VI using less than 64 devices
[*]Ten - Solve VI.5 using exactly ten devices
[*]Ghostbuster - Don't cross the beams in III.3
[/list]
[*]Added enhancement for colour-blind players
[*]Game saves whether the level was solved with clean solution in the past
[*]Added button that opens specific leaderboard in Steam Overlay
[*]Added more events that save user profile to avoid losing progress
[*]Languages fixes
[*]Fixed few bugs[/list]

[b]Note for "Cleaner" achievement[/b]: you have to run levels solutions once again to make it save whether it is clean solution. It is because of updated level solution save file structure.

Thank you all for the ideas for these features!
Enjoy ːartificialintelligenceː!
